items.title: CoreWeave AIRA: The autoresearch loop for continuous improvement
items.summary:
Meet CoreWeave ARIA, the AI Research and Iteration Agent that continuously improves your model and agent. In this demo, you will see how ARIA runs the full autoresearch loop. By continuously forming hypotheses, running experiments, evaluating results, and executing the best next actions, AIRA creates an autonomous research loop that helps models and agents improve while you focus on the problems that require human judgment. 

Get started: https://docs.wandb.ai/aria/overview

items.title: Announcing Retrieval Harness in LlamaParse Index
items.summary:
LlamaParse Index now has a retrieval harness: semantic search, server-side grep, file listing, and direct file reads — all as native tools in the agent loop.
Your agent can grep a file, list what's in an index, read past a chunk boundary, or run hybrid search with reranking.

items.title: CoreWeave ARIA: Deep analysis backed by live dashboards and full W&B context
items.summary:
Meet ARIA, the new AI coding assistant built directly into the Weights & Biases platform. Because ARIA has full context of your environment, it understands exactly what you're looking at, whether you're debugging a crash log or navigating a workspace with hundreds of thousands of panels and runs grouped and filtered into a custom view. Watch ARIA run deep analysis as a long-running background job, then summarize its findings in a shareable report backed by panels and visualizations. ARIA can also edit your workspace directly, setting baseline runs and creating new sections, panels, and saved views on command.

Get started: https://docs.wandb.ai/aria/overview

items.title: Introducing CoreWeave ARIA: AI Research and Iteration Agent
items.summary:
Meet CoreWeave ARIA, the AI agent built directly into the Weights & Biases platform. In this walkthrough, watch ARIA run a continuous auto-research loop, launching and improving experiments on its own, while handling everyday work in parallel: onboarding new team members, summarizing projects into reports, surfacing patterns across results, and building dynamic filters right into your workspace. Because ARIA has the full context of your environment, it understands your project, your runs, and everything stored in W&B without lengthy setup. And since every task runs as a cloud-based background job, you can kick off multiple threads at once and check in on live results from anywhere. Available on web and mobile.

Get started: https://docs.wandb.ai/aria/overview

items.title: Clicky Meets Universal-3.5: Voice-Navigate Your Code
items.summary:
Technical words are hard for speech recognition—but they don't have to be.

This demo shows how Clicky integrates AssemblyAI's Universal-3.5 model with dynamic key-term prompting. As the user scrolls through a codebase, Clicky automatically updates the transcription context with relevant identifiers, APIs, and technical terminology currently on screen.

The result is significantly more accurate recognition of developer-specific language, allowing users to ask natural voice questions like "Where is PCMS16LE?" or "What is audio PCM16 data doing?" and instantly navigate to the correct code.

Whether you're building developer tools, voice interfaces, or AI assistants, this is an example of how contextual prompting can improve transcription accuracy for technical workflows.
